entities.summary: Anastasiya Yakimova is a former tennis player from Belarus. She made it to the third round of the 2007 Australian Open, defeating Ai Sugiyama, a seeded player, on the way in the second round. Anastasiya Yakimova was a athletes & competitors from Minsk (b. 1986-11-01, Minsk). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
